title: ComposeVars: Docker Compose Variable Checker
description: Catch unset ${VAR} interpolation in docker-compose.yml / compose.yaml before `docker compose up`: checks against .env, .env.example and --env-file, flags missing env_file paths, host-side $VAR in command:, and committed secret defaults - values masked.

title: DeployRace: GitHub Actions Deploy Concurrency Checker
description: Finds deploy workflows that can run at the same time: GitHub Actions deploy jobs without concurrency, cancel-in-progress: true on deploys, two workflows deploying one environment with different groups, unscoped groups, per-PR previews, GitLab CI without resource_group. Quick Fixes, fully offline.

title: Model Name Hover
description: Hover any AI model ID (claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-4o-mini, gemini-2.5-flash) to see its vendor, family and version.

title: CRA Reporting Clock Lint (EU 2024/2847)
description: Checks SECURITY.md against the EU Cyber Resilience Act clocks that went live 11 Sep 2026: 24h early warning, 72h notification, 14-day final report, 5-year support period, CVD policy, SBOM.

title: Crypto Export Notice Lint (EAR 742.15)
description: Checks a README or EXPORT notice against the US EAR 742.15(b) publication items: BIS and NSA emails, published source URL, ECCN line, notification date, and the removed 740.13(e) citation.

title: EU Data Act Switching Clause Lint
description: Lint cloud/SaaS contract text for EU Data Act Chapter VI switching clauses: notice period, transition window, retrieval window, egress and switching charges, export format.

title: Declaración de Accesibilidad Lint (RD 1112/2018)
description: Revisa la declaración de accesibilidad de una web pública española contra el art. 15 del RD 1112/2018 y el modelo UE 2018/1523: fecha anual, plazo de 20 días hábiles, reclamación y contenido no accesi
